triage.name: needs-triage
triage.description: Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue

triage.name: ready-for-agent
triage.description: Fully specified and grabbable; a triage state, not an AFK trigger

triage.name: ready-for-human
triage.description: Needs a human: a decision to settle or work an agent cannot do

priority.name: priority:urgent
priority.description: Breaks money, data or the live event, or the next event cannot run without it

priority.name: priority:next
priority.description: The short list to pull from next (keep to ~15)

priority.name: priority:later
priority.description: Worth doing, no blocker, not scheduled

priority.name: priority:parked
priority.description: Deliberately not now; the issue names its wake-up trigger

type.name: chore
type.description: Dependencies, tooling, CI, docs or operations

type.name: question
type.description: A decision to settle rather than work to do

agent.name: agent:to-issues
agent.description: AFK: PRD ready to be decomposed into sub-issues

agent.name: agent:implement
agent.description: AFK: ready for an implement run

agent.name: agent:queued
agent.description: AFK: ready but waiting on declared blockers; auto-promotes. Human-applied only.

agent.name: agent:in-progress
agent.description: AFK: run active (acts as a lock)

agent.name: agent:review
agent.description: AFK: PR ready for the automated review workflow

agent.name: agent:blocked
agent.description: AFK: run failed or was refused; needs human attention before retrying

agent.name: agent:update-branch
agent.description: AFK: the PR must be merged up with its base

agent.name: agent:ready
agent.description: AFK: the review left nothing for a human; arm auto-merge or merge on green

agent.name: agent:needs-decision
agent.description: AFK: the review left a call for a human; pick it up with /review-triage

provenance.name: source:architecture-review
provenance.description: Provenance: PRD proposed by the Architecture Review workflow
